scenarios.scenario: Update unavailable physical properties for a solid body

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is open in the MCAD Software with its solid body visible
no physical-property update has been requested for the body since this document instance was opened
the user right-clicks the body in the model browser
the user chooses Properties
the Body Properties dialog opens with the body name
mass, area, volume, and the X, Y, and Z coordinates of the center of gravity show N/A
the dialog displays a body appearance selector and OK and Cancel buttons
the user chooses Update
mass, area, volume, and the center of gravity coordinates display calculated values
the solid remains highlighted behind the dialog
the user chooses Cancel
the dialog closes
the solid remains visible
the user reopens Body Properties for the same body in the same session
the calculated physical properties remain displayed
the user chooses Cancel
the dialog closes
`fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is open in the MCAD Software with its solid body visible
the body appearance is set to As Part
the user opens Body Properties for the body from the model browser
the user opens the Body Appearance list
a scrollable list of named appearances is displayed
the user chooses Black
Body Appearance displays Black
the user chooses Cancel
the user reopens Body Properties for the same body
Body Appearance displays As Part
the solid remains visible
the user chooses Cancel
the dialog closes

scenarios.scenario: Apply and restore a body appearance

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is open in the MCAD Software with its solid body visible
the body appearance is set to As Part
the user opens Body Properties for the body from the model browser
the user selects Black in Body Appearance
the user chooses OK
the dialog closes
the solid is displayed with the Black appearance
the user reopens Body Properties for the same body
Body Appearance displays Black
the user selects As Part in Body Appearance
the user chooses OK
the dialog closes
the solid is displayed with the part appearance
`fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is open in the MCAD Software with its solid body visible
Body Properties is open for the body
the user presses Escape
the dialog closes
the body row remains selected in the model browser
the solid remains highlighted in the viewport

scenarios.scenario: Discard a pending appearance with Escape

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is open in the MCAD Software with its solid body visible
the body appearance is set to As Part
Body Properties is open for the body
the user selects Black in Body Appearance
the user presses Escape
the dialog closes
the user reopens Body Properties for the same body
Body Appearance displays As Part
the user chooses Cancel
the dialog closes

scenarios.scenario: Discard a pending appearance using the title-bar close control

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is open in the MCAD Software with its solid body visible

Body Properties is open for the body
